rationale: The public Research Square report is an earlier protocol for the same hemodialysis trial. The matched full article does not report a numerical depression HADS result. The existing minimal easing anchor is preserved.

The new main paper and supplement give a favorable spillage component under a thicker chicken–shiitake formula and an inconclusive overall swallowing score. The printed Japanese original separately pools foods and diagnoses. The same author's 2013 Parkinson choking case text remains unavailable in the public sample.

The official primary paper and Table 2 were verified directly, including immediate and follow-up WOMAC means and the original registration identity. Two independent completed topical studies have no posted results. Allocation, schedule and masking discrepancies for the published trial remain open.

The separate refined-oil meal paper concerns gastric emptying without Parkinson or levodopa. The earlier primary abstract reports acute ground-soy ON duration. The secondary report's roast and duration details lack full-original confirmation and it disagrees on medication amount and metabolite directions. The separate ingredient overlay remains open.
NCT06944392 remains completed without numerical results for the symptom index. The full original pain-domain table and processing grade for the separate tadalafil combination remain unverified.
UMIN000056794 remains unpublished for the everyday fatigue VAS. UMIN000028271 and its linked original report respiratory outcomes while the registered fatigue VAS values remain unavailable.

The later report attributes a null catalepsy comparison to isolated cinnamaldehyde in Churihar 2022. Search found conflicting bibliography details and no verified primary group data. Existing ground-cinnamon gait-proxy scoring remains unchanged.
